topic: A person discovers their child has the same teacher they had
text: Seeing the name on the school list brought old memories rushing back. That same teacher, the one who shaped my days with a mix of challenge and warmth, now stands in my child’s path. I can’t help but wonder what they will share, the stories and lessons that made such a mark on me. A part of me wishes for a fresh start, an untraveled path for my child. But then, there’s the comfort in continuity, the familiarity of it. I just hope the world has grown as they have, and that what they offer will be as right for my child as it once was for me.
